abstract: This report illustrates a rare genetic disorder, Currarino syndrome, in association with an unusual malignant transformation to a peripheral primitive neuroectodermal tumour within a sacral teratoma. The triad of features consists of a presacral mass, partial sacral agenesis and anorectal anomalies. The most common presentation is constipation. In this case there was a history of constipation, teratomas and spinal abnormalities in many of the family members over three generations. Detailed family history taken at time of initial presentation may have prevented delay in diagnosis and averted the need for intensive treatment, which may well cause late sequelae.
abstract_ja: 本論文は、稀な遺伝性疾患であるCurrarino症候群を報告する。この疾患は仙骨前部腫瘤、仙骨形成不全、肛門直腸奇形を特徴とする。本症例では、3世代にわたり多くの家族に便秘、奇形腫、脊椎異常の既往がみられた。症例は仙骨奇形腫を有し、末梢性原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍への悪性転化を伴っていた。詳細な家族歴の聴取は、診断の遅れを防ぎ、集中的な治療とその晩期合併症を回避できた可能性がある。
